programs.product: Mac mini (2023, M2)
programs.issue: A very small percentage of Mac mini (2023) units may stop powering on.
programs.eligibility: Units manufactured between June 16, 2024 and November 23, 2024; covered for three years after the first retail sale of the unit.
programs.remedy: Free service by Apple or an Apple Authorized Service Provider.
programs.howTo: Enter your serial number on the program page, then book service at an Apple Store or an Apple Authorized Service Provider.

programs.product: iPhone 14 Plus
programs.issue: The rear camera on a very small percentage of iPhone 14 Plus devices may show no preview.
programs.eligibility: Devices manufactured between April 10, 2023 and April 28, 2024; covered for three years after the first retail sale of the unit.
programs.remedy: Free repair by Apple or an Apple Authorized Service Provider; if you already paid for this repair you can ask Apple about a refund.
programs.howTo: Check your serial number on the program page, back up the phone, then book a repair at an Apple Store, an Apple Authorized Service Provider, or by mail through Apple Support.

programs.product: MacBook Pro (Retina, 15-inch, Mid 2015)
programs.issue: The battery in some units may overheat and pose a fire safety risk.
programs.eligibility: Units sold primarily between September 2015 and February 2017; eligibility is determined by serial number.
programs.remedy: Free battery replacement by Apple or an Apple Authorized Service Provider.
programs.howTo: Enter your serial number on the program page; if eligible, stop using the laptop and book service at an Apple Store, a provider, or by mail.

programs.product: Apple three-prong AC wall plug adapter (UK, Singapore, Hong Kong)
programs.issue: In very rare cases the adapter can break and expose metal parts, creating a risk of electrical shock.
programs.eligibility: White adapters with no letters in the inside slot, shipped from 2003 to 2010 with Mac and certain iOS devices and in the World Travel Adapter Kit; Apple USB power adapters are not affected.
programs.remedy: Free exchange for a new, redesigned adapter.
programs.howTo: Bring the adapter and the serial number of your Apple device to an Apple Store or an Apple Authorized Service Provider, or contact Apple Support.

programs.product: Apple two-prong AC wall plug adapter (Continental Europe, Australia, New Zealand, Korea, Argentina, Brazil)
programs.issue: In rare cases these adapters can break and create a risk of electrical shock if touched.
programs.eligibility: Adapters shipped from 2003 to 2015 that have four or five characters, or no characters, in the slot that attaches to the power adapter; redesigned adapters with a three-letter regional code are not affected.
programs.remedy: Free exchange for a redesigned adapter; a refund is available if you paid for a replacement because of this issue.
programs.howTo: Bring the adapter and your device serial number to an Apple Store or an Apple Authorized Service Provider, or contact Apple Support.

programs.product: Beats Pill XL speaker
programs.issue: The speaker's battery can overheat in rare cases and pose a fire safety risk.
programs.eligibility: All Beats Pill XL speakers (black, white, pink, metallic sky, titanium); no other Beats products are affected.
programs.remedy: Apple Store credit or electronic payment of 325 USD after the speaker is returned.
programs.howTo: Stop using the speaker, submit the return request on the program page, and ship it back in the postage-paid box Apple sends.

programs.product: Apple 5W European USB power adapter (model A1300)
programs.issue: In rare cases the adapter may overheat and pose a safety risk.
programs.eligibility: Model A1300 adapters with solid gray CE lettering that shipped with iPhone 3GS, 4 and 4S from October 2009 to September 2012 in the listed countries, or were sold separately; redesigned model A1400 adapters are not affected.
programs.remedy: Free exchange for a redesigned adapter.
programs.howTo: Bring the adapter and your iPhone to an Apple Store or a participating Apple Authorized Service Provider, or contact Apple Support.

programs.product: Apple Ultracompact USB power adapter (iPhone 3G)
programs.issue: Under certain conditions the adapter's metal prongs can break off and remain in the outlet, creating a risk of electric shock.
programs.eligibility: Ultracompact adapters supplied with iPhone 3G in the US, Japan, Canada, Mexico and several Latin American countries, or sold separately; adapters with a green dot on the bottom are already redesigned.
programs.remedy: Free exchange for a redesigned adapter.
programs.howTo: Order a replacement through Apple Support with your iPhone serial number and IMEI, or visit an Apple Store with the adapter and your iPhone 3G.

programs.product: Pixel 9 Pro and Pixel 9 Pro XL
programs.issue: A limited number of devices may show a vertical line from the bottom to the top of the display, or display flicker.
programs.eligibility: Qualifying devices are covered for 3 years after the original retail purchase date; the phone is inspected first, and cracked glass, liquid damage or other out-of-warranty damage may disqualify it.
programs.remedy: Display replacement at no charge, warranted for 90 days or the rest of the original warranty.
programs.howTo: Start a walk-in or mail-in repair at store.google.com/repair or an authorized repair partner; back up your data and turn on Repair mode first.

programs.product: Pixel 9 Pro Fold
programs.issue: A limited number of devices may develop issues that affect the functionality of the device.
programs.eligibility: Covered for 3 years after the original retail purchase date, one replacement per device; cracked glass, liquid intrusion or other out-of-warranty damage may disqualify a device.
programs.remedy: Replacement device at no charge, warranted for 90 days or the rest of the original warranty.
programs.howTo: Check your options at store.google.com/repair; the phone is inspected before replacement and you may need proof of ownership.

programs.product: Pixel 8
programs.issue: A limited number of Pixel 8 phones may show a vertical line running from the bottom of the display to the top, or display flicker.
programs.eligibility: Phones with an IMEI or serial number identified as qualifying; covered for 3 years from the original retail purchase date; Pixel 8 Pro and Pixel 8a are not included.
programs.remedy: One free display replacement, warranted for 90 days.
programs.howTo: Enter your IMEI at the Google Store repair page to check eligibility, then book with an authorized repair partner.

programs.product: Pixel 7a
programs.issue: Some Pixel 7a phones may experience unexpected battery swelling.
programs.eligibility: Impacted devices are covered for 3 years from the original retail purchase date; devices bought in the US, Canada, UK, EEA, Switzerland, Australia, India, Japan, Malaysia, Singapore or Taiwan; a physical inspection is required.
programs.remedy: One battery replacement at no charge while supplies last; where repair is not available, a payment or Google Store credit may be offered instead.
programs.howTo: Register the phone at g.co/pixel/7abattery to check eligibility, then use a walk-in center or, in the US, mail-in repair.

programs.product: Fitbit Ionic smartwatch (model FB503)
programs.issue: In very limited instances the battery can overheat, posing a burn hazard.
programs.eligibility: Ionic owners, including inactive users, who bought the watch before the recall announcement and still have the device; proof of purchase or ownership may be requested.
programs.remedy: Refund of 299 USD; no replacement Ionic devices are offered.
programs.howTo: Stop using the watch and register at fitbitionic.expertinquiry.com; the refund is issued by Google's third-party vendor.

programs.product: Samsung slide-in electric ranges with front-mounted knobs (30 listed models sold 2013-2024)
programs.issue: The front knobs can be turned on by accidental contact from people or pets, which is a fire hazard if items are left on the cooktop.
programs.eligibility: US owners of the listed model numbers; the kit is free regardless of warranty status.
programs.remedy: A free set of knob locks or knob covers, depending on the model.
programs.howTo: Enter the range's 15-digit serial number on the Samsung page and submit the shipping form, or call 1-833-775-0120.

programs.product: Bass modules sold with select Acoustimass, Lifestyle and Companion home theater systems
programs.issue: Electrical components in the bass module can fail under certain conditions and pose a fire hazard.
programs.eligibility: Bass modules manufactured before April 1, 2006; check the product name and serial number on the module's label against the list on the Bose page.
programs.remedy: Free repair after you return the module, or a 40% discount on a new Bose soundbar in exchange for the module.
programs.howTo: Stop using and unplug the module, then use the self-service option on the Bose page (17-digit serial numbers) or call 888-260-0819.

programs.product: Hyundai Sonata 2011-2019, Santa Fe Sport 2013-2018, Santa Fe 2019, Tucson 2014-2015 and 2018-2019 with Theta II 2.0T or 2.4L engines
programs.issue: Connecting rod bearing wear in Theta II engines can cause a knocking noise, a check engine light with code P1326, stalling or engine failure.
programs.eligibility: Limited lifetime warranty for original and subsequent owners on engine long block repair or replacement due to connecting rod bearing wear, provided the free Knock Sensor Detection System software update (Service Campaign 953) has been completed.
programs.remedy: Free engine inspection and, if needed, engine replacement at a Hyundai dealer.
programs.howTo: Have the free KSDS update done at a Hyundai dealer, then bring the car in for inspection if the check engine light shows P1326 or the engine knocks.

programs.product: Hyundai Elantra 2014-2016, Elantra GT 2014-2020, Tucson 2010-2015 and 2016-2021, Santa Fe 2010-2012, Sonata Hybrid 2011-2019, Veloster 2012-2017 (Nu 2.0 GDI, Theta II 2.4 MPI or Gamma 1.6 GDI engines)
programs.issue: Connecting rod bearing wear can cause a check engine light with code P1326, abnormal engine noise, or a no-crank/no-start condition.
programs.eligibility: Engine repair or replacement for connecting rod bearing wear is covered for 15 years or 150,000 miles from original retail delivery, for original and subsequent owners; the free Knock Sensor Detection System update (campaign 966 or 982) is required, and commercial fleets and salvaged vehicles are excluded.
programs.remedy: Free engine inspection and engine replacement or ECU software update at a Hyundai dealer, with a rental car during the repair.
programs.howTo: Ask a Hyundai dealer to complete the KSDS update and inspect the engine; the dealer submits a prior-approval request under the extended warranty.

programs.product: Kia Optima 2011-2014, Sorento 2012-2018, Sportage 2011-2013 with 2.4L GDI or 2.0L turbo GDI engines
programs.issue: Excessive connecting rod bearing wear can lead to engine knock, a flashing check engine light with code P1326, limp mode and engine failure.
programs.eligibility: After the free Knock Sensor Detection System software update is installed, Kia provides lifetime engine warranty coverage for engine long block repairs needed because of bearing damage, for new and used vehicle owners; keep maintenance records.
programs.remedy: Free engine long block repair or replacement at a Kia dealer.
programs.howTo: Schedule the free KSDS software update at a Kia dealer; if the check engine light later flashes with code P1326, return to the dealer for the covered repair.

programs.product: Kia Soul 2012-2016 (1.6L GDI) and Forte/Forte Koup 2016 (2.0L GDI)
programs.issue: Excessive connecting rod bearing wear can damage the engine.
programs.eligibility: After the free Knock Sensor Detection System update, Kia warrants engine long block repairs needed due to connecting rod bearing damage for 15 years or 150,000 miles from the date the vehicle was first put into service, for new and used owners; proper maintenance records may be required.
programs.remedy: Free engine long block repair or replacement at a Kia dealer.
programs.howTo: Book the free KSDS software update (about one hour) at a Kia dealer and keep the notice with your warranty papers.

programs.product: Honda Accord Hybrid 2018-2022 and Accord 2018-2020 (manual transmission)
programs.issue: Reduced cylinder head gasket effectiveness can cause overheating, coolant loss, misfire or codes P0300-P0304.
programs.eligibility: Cylinder head gasket coverage for this condition is extended to 10 years from the original purchase date or 150,000 miles, whichever comes first; the Accord Hybrid extension applies even to vehicles with branded or salvage titles; eligibility is checked by VIN at a dealer.
programs.remedy: Free head gasket replacement, plus cylinder head or short block replacement if warpage is found.
programs.howTo: Ask a Honda dealer to run a VIN status inquiry and perform the head gasket inspection under service bulletins 26-006 or 26-004.

programs.product: Honda Civic 1.5L turbo (CVT) 2016-2017
programs.issue: Reduced cylinder head gasket effectiveness can cause overheating, coolant loss, misfire or codes P0300-P0304.
programs.eligibility: Cylinder head gasket coverage for this condition runs to May 31, 2027 or 150,000 miles, whichever comes first; repair orders after that date are not valid; eligibility is checked by VIN at a dealer.
programs.remedy: Free head gasket replacement, plus cylinder head or short block replacement if warpage is found.
programs.howTo: Ask a Honda dealer to run a VIN status inquiry and perform the head gasket inspection under service bulletin 26-099.

programs.product: Honda Accord 2017, Odyssey 2017, Pilot 2017-2018, Ridgeline 2017-2019 (6-speed automatic)
programs.issue: A cracked lock-up piston lets pressure bleed off so the torque converter clutch cannot hold, setting code P0741 with a flashing D and a transmission overheat message.
programs.eligibility: Torque converter warranty extended to 10 years or 150,000 miles from the original purchase date, whichever comes first; dealer diagnosis under bulletins 23-076, 23-077 or 23-078 is required.
programs.remedy: Free torque converter replacement at a Honda dealer.
programs.howTo: Have a Honda dealer run a VIN status inquiry and the diagnostic steps; qualifying vehicles get the torque converter replaced at no charge.

programs.product: Acura ADX 2025-2026 and Integra 2023-2026
programs.issue: Reduced cylinder head gasket effectiveness can cause overheating, coolant loss, misfire or codes P0300-P0304.
programs.eligibility: Cylinder head gasket coverage for this condition is extended to 10 years from the original purchase date or 150,000 miles, whichever comes first; owner notification began in October 2026.
programs.remedy: Free head gasket replacement, plus cylinder head or short block replacement if warpage is found.
programs.howTo: Ask an Acura dealer to run a VIN status inquiry and perform the inspection under service bulletins 26-001 to 26-003.

programs.product: Nissan Altima 2017-2018, Sentra 2018-2019, Versa Sedan and Versa Note 2018-2019 (CVT)
programs.issue: Continuously variable transmission concerns on these models, including those raised in class actions.
programs.eligibility: The CVT assembly and internal components, valve body, torque converter, cooler kit and TCM reprogramming are covered for 84 months or 84,000 miles instead of 60 months or 60,000 miles; owners who opted out of the settlement are excluded, so coverage is checked by VIN.
programs.remedy: Free CVT repair or replacement at a Nissan dealer within the extended period.
programs.howTo: Bring the car to a Nissan dealer, which verifies coverage for the VIN and diagnoses the CVT.

programs.product: Subaru Forester 2019-2023, Impreza and Crosstrek 2019-2023, WRX/STI 2019-2023, Ascent 2019-2022, Outback and Legacy 2019-2022 (Gen 3.1 and CP1 head units)
programs.issue: The infotainment head unit can fail with a black or blank screen, loss of audio, repeated rebooting, or loss of CarPlay/Android Auto, navigation, Bluetooth or touchscreen functions.
programs.eligibility: New Vehicle Limited Warranty on the head unit is extended to 8 years or 150,000 miles for the listed failures; one-time replacement after reprogramming has been tried; external damage and other audio components are not covered.
programs.remedy: Free software reprogramming or a one-time head unit replacement at a Subaru retailer.
programs.howTo: Have a Subaru retailer diagnose the head unit; earlier paid repairs may qualify for reimbursement through the hotline at 877-551-7149.

programs.product: Subaru Crosstrek Plug-in Hybrid 2019-2023
programs.issue: The front exhaust pipe can crack at the exhaust manifold junction, causing an exhaust leak, noise or odor.
programs.eligibility: Federal emissions defect warranty for the front exhaust pipe is extended from 8 years/80,000 miles to 15 years/150,000 miles, and all affected vehicles are covered regardless of mileage through November 17, 2026.
programs.remedy: Free front exhaust pipe repair at a Subaru retailer.
programs.howTo: Contact a Subaru retailer; the extension shows on the vehicle inquiry for the VIN, and earlier paid repairs may be reimbursed.

programs.product: Cadillac Escalade and Escalade ESV, Chevrolet Tahoe and Suburban, GMC Yukon and Yukon XL, 2022
programs.issue: A worn transmission control valve can lose pressure, causing harsh shifting, reduced engine performance, a service engine soon message or code P0747.
programs.eligibility: Special Coverage N252536751 covers the condition for 15 years or 150,000 miles from the original in-service date, regardless of ownership; safety recall N252536750 must be completed first.
programs.remedy: Free replacement of the valve body spacer plate, actuator feed valve and spring at a GM dealer; earlier paid repairs may be reimbursed.
programs.howTo: Ask a Chevrolet, GMC or Cadillac dealer to check the VIN in GM's warranty system and complete the recall and the special coverage repair.

programs.product: Cadillac Escalade and Escalade ESV, Chevrolet Tahoe and Suburban, GMC Yukon and Yukon XL, 2021 (diesel engine)
programs.issue: The cylinder 2 glow plug can fail, turning on the check engine light and setting a trouble code.
programs.eligibility: Special Coverage N262552620 covers the condition for 15 years or 150,000 miles from the original in-service date, regardless of ownership.
programs.remedy: Free glow plug replacement at a GM dealer; earlier paid repairs may be reimbursed.
programs.howTo: Ask a Chevrolet, GMC or Cadillac dealer to check the VIN in Investigate Vehicle History and perform the repair.

programs.product: Jeep Wrangler 4xe 2024-2025 and Grand Cherokee 4xe 2023-2025 (2.0L turbo PHEV engine)
programs.issue: Engine knock with codes P2336-P2339 (knock sensor threshold exceeded) on some vehicles.
programs.eligibility: Vehicles with the 2.0L turbo PHEV engine built June 7, 2023 to May 30, 2025 (Wrangler) or July 19, 2023 to April 10, 2025 (Grand Cherokee); coverage is unlimited years and miles from completion of safety recall 78C, and one of the listed codes must be set.
programs.remedy: Free engine repair or replacement at a Jeep dealer; earlier paid repairs can be claimed at fcarecallreimbursement.com.
programs.howTo: Ask a Jeep dealer to check the VIN for the XC2 coverage message and diagnose the knock codes.

programs.product: Jeep Wrangler 4xe 2021-2025 and Grand Cherokee 4xe 2022-2026
programs.issue: The high-voltage battery pack may set codes for cell balancing, voltage variation, unstable voltage or failed state of health and turn on the check engine light.
programs.eligibility: Vehicles with the 2.0L PHEV engine; battery pack coverage for these codes is unlimited years and miles from the in-service date.
programs.remedy: Free high-voltage battery pack diagnosis and replacement at a Jeep dealer.
programs.howTo: Ask a Jeep dealer to check the VIN for the XU1 coverage message; earlier paid repairs can be claimed at fcarecallreimbursement.com.

programs.product: Chrysler Pacifica Hybrid and Voyager Hybrid 2017-2021 (3.6L V6 hybrid)
programs.issue: The high-voltage battery pack may set codes P0EDD, P0BBE or P1C5E and turn on the check engine light.
programs.eligibility: Hybrid vehicles built on or before October 21, 2021; coverage for these codes is unlimited years and miles from the in-service date.
programs.remedy: Free high-voltage battery pack replacement at a Chrysler dealer.
programs.howTo: Ask a Chrysler dealer to check the VIN for the XT1 coverage message; earlier paid repairs can be claimed at fcarecallreimbursement.com.

programs.product: Ram 3500, 4500 and 5500, 2022 (Aisin 6-speed automatic)
programs.issue: The transmission may not shift into or out of 1st-4th gears, with the check engine light on and code P0731.
programs.eligibility: Trucks built June 5 to November 30, 2022 with the Aisin AS69RC or AS66RC transmission; the K1 clutch/input shaft assembly is covered for 10 years or 150,000 miles from the in-service date.
programs.remedy: Free K1 clutch/input shaft assembly replacement at a Ram dealer.
programs.howTo: Ask a Ram dealer to check the VIN for the XW1 coverage message; earlier paid repairs can be claimed at fcarecallreimbursement.com.

programs.product: Ford Bronco Sport 2021-2024, Escape 2021-2024, Maverick 2022-2024
programs.issue: A broken buckle sensor wire turns on the airbag warning light with code B0050:13 and a seat belt monitor fault.
programs.eligibility: Vehicles in the listed build date ranges; a no-cost one-time driver seat buckle replacement is available for 15 years or 250,000 miles from the warranty start date, and coverage transfers to later owners.
programs.remedy: Free one-time replacement of the driver's side seat buckle.
programs.howTo: If the airbag light comes on with this code, book a repair at a Ford dealer under Customer Satisfaction Program 24N08.

programs.product: Ford Mustang 2015-2019, Transit 2016-2019, Econoline 2017-2019, Super Duty 2017-2019, Ranger 2019, Lincoln Navigator 2015-2017
programs.issue: The rear view camera may show a blank or distorted image, or a camera-unavailable message, when the vehicle is in reverse.
programs.eligibility: Vehicles inspected under safety recall 25S89 that did not need a camera at that time; a one-time camera replacement is available for 15 years and unlimited miles from the warranty start date, and vehicles already past that limit have until December 2026.
programs.remedy: Free one-time rear view camera replacement, parts and labor.
programs.howTo: If the camera image fails, book a service appointment at a Ford or Lincoln dealer under Customer Satisfaction Program 25N15.

programs.product: Toyota Highlander Hybrid 2017-2019
programs.issue: Internal malfunction of the brake booster or brake booster pump assembly, stored as codes C1391, C1252, C1253 or C1256.
programs.eligibility: Customer Support Program 24TE05: after the primary coverage ended on January 30, 2026, secondary coverage applies for 10 years or 150,000 miles from the date of first use, whichever comes first; work must be done at a Toyota dealer.
programs.remedy: Free replacement of the brake booster and brake booster pump assemblies.
programs.howTo: Contact a Toyota dealer to verify the code and perform the repair under the program.

programs.product: Toyota Tacoma 2016-2022 (Super White 040 paint)
programs.issue: Paint may peel on the exterior door window frames, the front inner fender edges and the A-pillars.
programs.eligibility: Customer Support Program 23TE08 is offered for 10 years from the date of first use regardless of mileage; only peeling white paint in the specified areas qualifies, and the inspection must be done at a Toyota dealer or Toyota Certified Collision Center.
programs.remedy: Free strip and repaint of the affected areas on the affected side of the truck.
programs.howTo: Book an inspection at a Toyota dealer; the dealer confirms the peeling before the repair.

programs.issue: Corrosion at the connector of the high-voltage floor under wire harness and rear traction motor cable can cause AM radio static or a no-start.
programs.eligibility: Customer Support Program 23LE05 covers the condition for 10 years with unlimited miles if campaign LSC 25LD01 is completed by September 30, 2028; otherwise coverage is 8 years or 100,000 miles from first use.
programs.remedy: Free repair or replacement of the affected wire harness or cable at a Lexus dealer.
programs.howTo: Contact a Lexus dealer to complete LSC 25LD01 and have the harness inspected.

programs.product: Hydro Flask insulated bottles, tumblers and caps
programs.issue: Limited lifetime warranty against manufacturer defects, such as broken or leaking caps, lost insulation or uneven rim welds, for the life of the product.
programs.eligibility: Product bought from Hydro Flask or an authorized retailer; dents, scratches, chipped powder coat and other wear, misuse or modification are not covered.
programs.remedy: Replacement with the same size and color, or a similar item of at least equal value.
programs.howTo: Submit the warranty form on help.hydroflask.com (a photo may be required and you may pay return shipping), or contact the retailer you bought from.

programs.product: Vortex riflescopes, red dots, rangefinders, binoculars, apparel and accessories
programs.issue: Unlimited, unconditional lifetime warranty: a damaged or defective product is repaired or replaced at no charge, whatever the cause and wherever it was bought.
programs.eligibility: No receipt or warranty card needed; loss, theft, deliberate damage and cosmetic blemishes that do not affect performance are excluded.
programs.remedy: Repair or replacement at no charge.
programs.howTo: Call 1-800-4VORTEX or use the Contact Us button on the warranty page to start the inspection and repair.

programs.product: JanSport packs, bags, pouches, totes and cases
programs.issue: Manufacturing defects in materials (zippers, buckles, fabric) and workmanship (seams, construction) for the lifetime of the product.
programs.eligibility: Original owner in the US or Canada, items bought from authorized dealers; accidents, improper care, normal wear, fading and liquid damage are not covered, and cooler bags have a 5-year warranty.
programs.remedy: Free repair or replacement at JanSport's discretion, shipped back free of charge.
programs.howTo: Submit the online claim form with photos of the damage and the product tag, or call 1-800-426-9227; you prepay shipping to the warranty center.

programs.product: Nalgene bottles and containers
programs.issue: Lifetime guarantee covering functional damage from regular, intended use, such as cracks, breaks or broken components.
programs.eligibility: Lost or stolen items, Epic filter products and cosmetic wear such as scratches, nicks or worn prints are not covered; all claims are reviewed.
programs.remedy: Replacement bottle.
programs.howTo: Submit the warranty/replacement form on nalgene.com with a photo of the bottle; allow 14 to 21 days for the replacement to ship.

programs.product: Channellock pliers, wrenches, snips, drivers, pry bars and levels
programs.issue: Built Strong Limited Lifetime Warranty: a tool that fails is inspected and replaced.
programs.eligibility: Normal wear such as rounded teeth or loose joints, alterations, hot-wire damage, misuse, lack of maintenance and overload breakage can be rejected; retailer and purchase date are optional on the claim form.
programs.remedy: Replacement tool.
programs.howTo: Exchange at a participating retailer (Home Depot, Lowe's, Do it Best), submit the online claim form with a photo, or call 1-800-724-3018.

programs.product: Leupold riflescopes, mounts, red dots, binoculars and spotting scopes
programs.issue: Optics are guaranteed to perform for life with no time limit; a product that fails to perform is repaired or replaced free.
programs.eligibility: No proof of ownership or warranty card is needed and the guarantee applies whether or not you are the original owner; modified, misused or abused products are excluded, and electronics such as rangefinders have 5-year coverage.
programs.remedy: Free repair or replacement.
programs.howTo: Call 1-800-LEUPOLD and contact Leupold Product Service before any repair work is done.

programs.product: Kershaw knives
programs.issue: Limited lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects in materials and construction for the lifetime of the original owner, plus free sharpening and replacement parts.
programs.eligibility: Original owner only (non-transferable), knives bought in the US or Mexico; normal wear, rust, misuse such as prying, modified knives and counterfeits are excluded.
programs.remedy: Repair or replacement at Kai USA's option; a voucher for discontinued models.
programs.howTo: Complete the warranty/service form, include the 7 USD return shipping fee, and mail the clean knife to Kai USA in Tualatin, Oregon.

programs.product: Stanley hand tools
programs.issue: Limited lifetime warranty against deficiencies in material and workmanship for as long as the original purchaser owns the tool.
programs.eligibility: Excessive wear, misuse, abuse, alteration and unauthorized repairs are not covered; consumables such as blades, bits and staples are excluded, and tools with electronics are limited to one year.
programs.remedy: Repair or replacement.
programs.howTo: Send the tool to Stanley Black & Decker, 100 Passmore Lane, Jackson, TN 38305, Attn: Quality Assurance, or call 1-800-262-2161.

programs.product: GearWrench mechanics hand tools
programs.issue: Manufacturing defects are covered for the lifetime of the original end-user purchaser.
programs.eligibility: Consumables such as bits, taps and dies and cutting tools, normal wear, misuse and tools from unauthorized sellers are not covered; proof of purchase may be requested for some purchases.
programs.remedy: Free repair or replacement, with shipping of replacements paid by GearWrench.
programs.howTo: Submit the warranty replacement form on gearwrench.com, call 877-626-3433 or email warrantysupport@apextoolgroup.com; a photo may be enough under the EZ Warranty.

programs.product: Tervis classic double-wall drinkware and covered stainless steel bottles
programs.issue: Lifetime guarantee covering chipping or peeling, cracked or failed decoration, seal failure and stainless steel thermal defects on covered products.
programs.eligibility: Lids, accessories and some products such as the Legacy Classic water bottle are not covered; items sent in that are not covered are recycled and not returned.
programs.remedy: Replacement product or credit; keeping your decoration on a new product costs 12.50 USD.
programs.howTo: Fill out the online Guarantee Replacement Form, print it and mail it with the product; processing takes 45 to 60 business days.

programs.product: Victorinox knives, cutlery, tableware, sharpening tools and kitchen utensils
programs.issue: Material or manufacturing defects are covered for the lifetime of the product under normal use.
programs.eligibility: Products bought from Victorinox or an authorized seller; proof of purchase may be requested; normal wear, cosmetic damage, misuse, accidents and modifications are excluded, and a handling fee may apply.
programs.remedy: Repair, or replacement with an identical or equivalent model if repair is not possible; return shipping is paid by Victorinox.
programs.howTo: Contact Victorinox, an authorized seller or a service center (store finder on the site) and ship or bring the product in.

programs.product: Thule carriers, racks, technical backpacks, luggage, bike racks and trailers, laptop and camera bags, stroller frames
programs.issue: Limited lifetime warranty against defects in materials or workmanship for the listed product categories.
programs.eligibility: Original purchaser with the original receipt or invoice; normal wear, scratches, accidents, overloading, modifications and unauthorized repairs are not covered.
programs.remedy: Repair within 30 days, or replacement, refund or store credit if repair is not possible.
programs.howTo: Submit Thule's online warranty claim form with proof of purchase and at least three photos or videos; postage for mailed-in products is refunded.

programs.product: Milwaukee hand tools
programs.issue: Limited lifetime warranty against defects in material and workmanship for the lifetime of the tool.
programs.eligibility: Original purchaser from an authorized Milwaukee distributor; misuse, alterations, abuse, normal wear, lack of maintenance and accidents are excluded; registration is not required and a copy of the invoice helps verification.
programs.remedy: Repair or replacement of the hand tool.
programs.howTo: Contact Milwaukee or an authorized distributor; some products use the online submission form with a photo and part number.

programs.product: Klean Kanteen bottles, cups and food containers
programs.issue: Strong as Steel Lifetime Limited Warranty against manufacturing defects for as long as the original purchaser owns the product.
programs.eligibility: Original US purchaser from Klean Kanteen or an authorized seller; proof of purchase and a photo are required; misuse, cleaning or disassembly damage, modifications, normal wear and abuse are excluded.
programs.remedy: Repair or replacement, or a refund if neither is practical.
programs.howTo: Submit the online warranty form or call 1-800-767-3173; a prepaid label is provided if the product must be mailed back.

programs.product: Briggs & Riley luggage and bags
programs.issue: The Simple as that guarantee covers repair of all functional aspects of the bag for life, including airline damage.
programs.eligibility: No proof of purchase is mentioned; cosmetic wear, stains, odors, contents, UV or water discoloration from improper storage, and lost or stolen bags are not covered.
programs.remedy: Free repair; identical parts may be unavailable for discontinued models.
programs.howTo: Submit a repair through the online form, use an authorized repair center, or order a self-repair kit; you pay shipping to Briggs & Riley and return shipping is free.
